notes: Fair and solvable. The vegetarian clue is nicely disguised: Mina downplays it ('i can always just pick the pepperoni off') and Brooke corrects her, so a careless reader might miss it, which is the intended twist. Each decoy fails on exactly one axis (meat-only, heavy, no pizza), and all four are $, so the budget does not eliminate anything; it acts as a red herring. Every scoring fact was in the reviews. Slice Society's meat-only rule is stated plainly, and 'won't make one without' closes the loophole. Mina's 'i can just get a salad' line invites a Green Bean pick, but the group overrules it at once, so it is not unfair. Slightly easy once the vegetarian line is spotted.
